dataset_name: BANDA + JNPA 2.5 m PAN / texture land cover + fine-tuned SegFormer roads V9

road_specialist.loss: road-weighted CE 3.5 + road Tversky + 0.4 soft clDice
road_specialist.augmentation: flips, 90-degree rotations, brightness, contrast, gamma, CLAHE, blur, noise

input_requirements: Single-band PAN TIFF. Developed on 2.5 m BANDA/JNPA; other sensors/resolutions are not independently validated.
warning: Experimental weakly supervised model. Thin roads, bridges and low-contrast roads can still be missed. Bright narrow roofs and linear field boundaries may remain false positives. Displayed land-cover agreement is not road or five-class test accuracy.
validation_note: Land-cover scores are unchanged and cover water, urban and vegetation, not independent five-class ground truth. Road V9 uses the same 512/128 geographically separated partial reference patches. Its raw-head scores and final geometry-filter scores are different measurements. No city-wide road quota or geographic class overlay is used.
note: Unchanged PAN V8 land classifier and native radiometry; separately fine-tuned SegFormer road expert. The road pass blends 50-percent-overlapping probabilities on the full 2.5 m working grid, rather than reducing big scenes to 5 m or requiring two views in singly covered interiors. Thin image-supported corridors, seed-and-grow hysteresis, compact-blob rejection and at-most-7.5 m model-supported gap repair improve continuity. Water, vegetation, clouds and Unknown are protected. Shapefiles remain on request only. The historical API model ID is retained for compatibility.
portable_normalization_note: No source imagery is redistributed. Uploaded scenes use the original adaptive scene normalization; parent-crop inheritance requires the original parent products.
